aerial-a.defect: Wake geometry is a chalk line that leads the boat, which a player will see instantly.

aerial-a.defect: Clone-tree spheres repeated hundreds of times without shape variation.
aerial-a.fix: Use 4-6 tree species with distinct silhouettes (palm, sea grape, casuarina), vary scale 0.7-1.4 and add sub-canopy undergrowth.

aerial-a.defect: Flat unlit box facades at B3-C3 and the featureless mainland plane at A3-D3 read as a prototype, and there is a hard ground/sky seam at y~283 px behind the skyline (D3).
aerial-a.fix: Add a window-grid facade atlas with emissive/AO variation for LOD1 towers, populate the mainland with a suburban block impostor layer, and blend the far ground into the sky with height fog matching skyHorizon.

aerial-a.defect: Wakes are uniform straight bars with no Kelvin angle (ref wakes open at ~19 deg with turbulent foam), and the boat hull is a 6 px orange blob.
aerial-a.fix: Replace the single-strip wake with a two-arm Kelvin V (half-angle 19.5 deg) plus a turbulent stern wash strip with noise-broken alpha; add a hull LOD with >= 30 px silhouette at this distance.

aerial-a.defect: Bridge supports do not reach the water - the deck floats over D4-E4 and A6-B6 with no piers - a protocol hard failure; cable fans render as solid alpha sheets.
aerial-a.fix: Instance pier columns every 40-60 m from deck to seabed with cast shadows, and render cables as line geometry (or thin quads with alpha-to-coverage) rather than a filled fan.

aerial-a.defect: Wakes are straight constant-width streaks instead of the reference's diverging V with Kelvin arms and turbulent foam that fades with distance.
aerial-a.fix: Replace the wake ribbon with a Kelvin-angle (19.5 deg) V mesh plus a fading turbulent centre band whose width grows with distance behind the hull.

aerial-a.defect: Wake at F8 is a uniform straight ribbon instead of a spreading V with turbulent centre.
aerial-a.fix: Replace the ribbon with a two-arm Kelvin wake (19.5 deg half-angle) plus a foamy centre trail that fades over ~200 m.

aerial-a.defect: Uniform broccoli-blob canopies with repeated silhouettes at C6-D7 and no palm trees anywhere on the island.
aerial-a.fix: Add a palm/coconut species set (30% of shoreline trees), vary crown shapes (3+ silhouettes, height variance 40%) and match the far-LOD impostor colours to near canopies.

aerial-a.defect: Empty mid-ground water and an uninhabited main island at B5-E8.
aerial-a.fix: Populate: 20-40 boats with wakes across C4-H6, a road with moving cars on the causeway, 10-15 beach houses and a small marina on the main island.

aerial-a.defect: Clouds read as flat sprites with aliased edges rather than volumes.
aerial-a.fix: Render clouds as volumetric/raymarched or layered impostors with soft alpha, a lit top and shadowed base gradient.

aerial-a.defect: Over-hazed grey upper sky and a hard 3 px horizon step.
aerial-a.fix: Reduce haze density above 10 deg elevation to keep blue [55,134,180] at the top, and blend the horizon over 12-20 px.

aerial-a.defect: No specular response on water; aircraft specular is uniform.
aerial-a.fix: Add a GGX sun highlight on the water normal map and vary aircraft roughness by material.
